resources.string: No board on USB. Connect it with a USB-OTG adapter and a data cable, to the board\'s own USB socket.
This board has no screen UI, or its firmware is older than 0.1.1-beta11: update it with Mava Flasher.
The board refused to share its screen.
The board does not answer: is the Mava firmware running? (Mava Flasher → Board log)
Type with the phone\'s keyboard (hide the board\'s touch keyboard)

Touch the picture to tap the handheld\'s screen. The buttons are its keys: call, menu, arrows, OK, back, end. Text you type here goes to the board as key presses, in any language your phone\'s keyboard has. One app at a time can use the board\'s USB: close Mava\'s LoRa-over-USB or the flasher first.
